about: A Markpad theme. Each colour is #RRGGBB in light and dark. editor = the paper, chrome = sidebar/tabs/status bar, ink = text, secondary = markers and captions, tertiary = bullets and dim captions, accent = caret/links/checks. washes are alphas (0-1) of the ink or accent; metrics are optional geometry (measure 320-1200, radii, widths). fonts name faces (serif, sans, mono, or an installed family) and the heading weight; scale is the type ladder at 17pt (h1-h6 size + leading, body and code leadings). colors.headings is the heading ink; overrides re-tints any palette colour by name (codeSpanFill, quoteBar, marker, bullet, cardFill, tableHeaderFill, linkUnderline, ...), #RRGGBBAA for a wash's alpha. chrome sets the window's radius (0 = square), sidebar row height (density) and tab height. Save the file and Markpad re-renders; Settings > General lists it by name.
name: Sepia
